answer: A bond of 42% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in reef, and island reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 38 aliases, and each one needs its own funded pearl account. A farm of 2096 identities would post 4374 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
